command:
$tools = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\tools"
$jdkDir = Join-Path $tools "jdk-21"
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $jdkDir "bin\java.exe"))) {
  "downloading JDK 21..."
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tools | Out-Null
  $zip = Join-Path $tools "jdk21.zip"
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/21/ga/windows/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse" -OutFile $zip
  "extracting..."
  Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $tools -Force
  Remove-Item $zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $extracted = Get-ChildItem $tools -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "jdk-21*" } | Select-Object -First 1
  if ($extracted -and $extracted.FullName -ne $jdkDir) { Move-Item $extracted.FullName $jdkDir -Force }
  "JDK ready"
} else { "JDK 21 already present" }
& (Join-Path $jdkDir "bin\java.exe") -version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
"=== generating wrapper with JDK 21 ==="
$env:JAVA_HOME = $jdkDir
$android = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner-app\android"
$gradleBat = Join-Path $tools "gradle-8.10.2\bin\gradle.bat"
& $gradleBat wrapper --gradle-version 8.10.2 -p $android 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $android "gradlew.bat")) { "WRAPPER OK" } else { "WRAPPER FAILED" }
